description: Second blind test: inputs released by the custodian under docs/blindtest/PROTOCOL_v2.md. Inputs only: no slopes, front widths, profile points or shape descriptions, except the designated calibration curve, released in full as calibration_<id>.csv. All other curves are sealed in ~/Documents/MATLAB/ald-blind-custody-v2/.
informative_note: PROTOCOL_v2 asks for at least six entering curves in two series. 11 curves enter, but all belong to ONE series under the protocol definition (same process, temperature and reactor). No second series with at least two entering curves was found.

series.process: Al2O3 from TMA/H2O, 300 C, Picosun R-150, ca. 3 hPa N2
series.varies: gap height (500, 2000 nm); cycles (500, 1000, 1080); TMA pulse (0.1, 0.2 s); purge (1, 4, 10 s); pillar layout (v1a, v1b, v2a); different chips and runs
series.calibration_rule: smallest filled fraction 2t/H among entering curves (ties: smallest half depth)
series.series_definition_note: The custodian applied the protocol wording literally: one series per process, temperature and reactor. The sub-series A-F of Yim 2020 Table 1 are given per curve (yim2020_table1_series) for reporting only.

curves.source: J. Yim, O. M. E. Ylivaara, M. Ylilammi, V. Korpelainen, E. Haimi, E. Verkama, M. Utriainen, R. L. Puurunen, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 22, 23107 (2020), doi:10.1039/D0CP03358H, and its ESI
curves.test_structure: PillarHall 3rd generation, rectangular lateral channel, membrane removed before measurement
curves.x50_definition: first downward crossing of 0.5 x plateau, 3-point running median, linear interpolation; plateau = median of the digitised points between 0.1 and 0.4 of x50 (x >= 5 um)

digitisation_error.method: raster digitisation, markers/line not individually resolved, values in 2 um bins

curves.predictor_prior_knowledge: Yim 2020 Table 1 row of this sample (authors' x50, slope at half thickness, R2, S_I, S_IIb) and the text of the paper; figure not seen; the same panel also shows sample 8, whose tabulated profile (Zenodo 3974438) the predictor has
curves.note: authors state (ESI section 3.1) that the 2000 nm channels had dry-etch fabrication issues (some features rounded, some channels narrowed); published profile is an average over repeated scans and lateral lengths
